meta.notes: sql_for('regime_priority'). Inputs are JSON and each case is recomputed from them; a raise is stored as {"raises": {"type", "message"}} (pydantic: "errors" instead of "message"). Polars frames are {columns, dtypes, rows}; pandas frames add index and write NA/NaN/NaT as null. Prices: close is adjusted, close_raw is the exchange print (house rule 6). Regenerate with `.venv/bin/python ../tools/parity/golden_ranking.py` from decile-blueprint.

output: (CASE regime WHEN 'BULL' THEN 2 WHEN 'NEUTRAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'BEAR' THEN 0 END)
